description: This file defines the class MathIllegalArgumentException, which serves as the base class for exceptions related to illegal argument conditions within the Apache Commons Math library. It extends IllegalArgumentException and implements ExceptionContextProvider, providing additional context information for exceptions triggered by invalid arguments.

classes.name: MathIllegalArgumentException
classes.description: A base exception class for invalid argument errors, carrying contextual information for debugging and localization.

methods.name: MathIllegalArgumentException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a localized message pattern and arguments, and sets up the exception context.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the exception context containing message and localization info.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Overrides Throwable.getMessage() to provide message from the exception context.

methods.name: getLocalizedMessage
methods.description: Overrides Throwable.getLocalizedMessage() to provide localized message from the exception context.
